span.normalized: Historically, through our Materials segment, we sold the vast majority of our rare earth concentrate to a single, principal customer in China under the terms of the Shenghe Offtake Agreement (as defined in Note 21, “Related-Party Transactions,” in the notes to the Consolidated Financial Statements). In July 2025, to align with the terms of the DoW Transaction Agreements and in further support of our domestic supply chain objectives, we ceased all sales of our products to China.
